subject.title: Add Codex fork-family provenance and missing-parent dedupe (#2037)

question: Should provisional value-fingerprint suppression ship with intentional undercount risk, and should it be reviewed independently from the open containment draft?
rationale: Even after repairing cancellation, this branch changes the accounting contract and combines two unmerged policies; tests cannot determine the acceptable product tradeoff or landing structure.

options.title: Isolate and strengthen
options.body: Extract the provenance slice onto the accepted main baseline, require stable family/cache behavior and real-corpus proof, then reconsider billing suppression.

options.title: Adopt combined conservative accounting
options.body: Accept the containment and inferred-prefix undercount policies together after explicit owner approval and end-to-end proof.

options.title: Keep fixtures, pause suppression
options.body: Retain the sanitized corpus and specifications while deferring production billing changes until provenance semantics are settled.

recommendation.title: Isolate and strengthen
recommendation.body: Extract the provenance slice onto the accepted main baseline, require stable family/cache behavior and real-corpus proof, then reconsider billing suppression.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the current main scanner orchestration and is the clearest decision point for the accounting and branch-structure choice.
